description: This interface defines a factory for creating authentication directives for HTTP and WebSocket APIs within the Gateway services of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationDirectiveFactory
classes.description: Interface for a factory that creates authentication directives for different protocols.

methods.name: buildHttpAuthentication
methods.description: Constructs and returns a GatewayAuthenticationDirective for HTTP API authentication.

methods.name: buildWsAuthentication
methods.description: Constructs and returns a GatewayAuthenticationDirective for WebSocket API authentication.
